subtitle: A WWII-era Air Force rescue-boat pier at Borinquen Field, later Ramey Air Force Base, turned civilian landmark — partially collapsed in Hurricane Erin (2025).
spike_statement: Built for Borinquen Field's WWII rescue boats, the pier long outlived that mission — until Hurricane Erin's swells collapsed part of it in August 2025.

levers.photo_tone: a sun-faded but still colorfully painted concrete pier over a shallow turquoise cove, scrubland behind where a Strategic Air Command runway used to run
